WatchedOver.description: Adjacent friendly units take <style="DMG_Psychic">-{[dmgReductionPct]}% Psychic Damage</style> from enemy attacks and if they have a <style="Stat_Block">Block</style> <style="Stat_Chance">chance</style>, that Block Chance is increased by <style="Stat">+{[blockChance]}%</style>. Enemy <style="Psyker">Psykers</style> will not hit an additional unit with their <style="NormalAttack">normal ranged attacks</style> when attacking units that are adjacent to a <style="Faction_DarkAngels">Watcher in the Dark</style>.
